notes.title: New Podcast Episode of Game Design Critics
notes.content:
We're excited to share a special treat for all fans of MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE and game design enthusiasts! Join us in the latest episode of Game Design Critics, hosted by the insightful "The Crancher," as we discuss MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE, the inspiration behind it, and our general game development inspirations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508716/2c030fccbbb3779e5cafa2fe27c6d03bb91ad950.jpg

Episode Highlights: 
    Exclusive Insights: Get a behind-the-scenes look at the development of MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE, as we share our journey, challenges, and triumphs in bringing this unique game to life.    Deep Dive into Game Design: Learn about the design decisions that shape the world of MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE. From world crafting to gameplay mechanics, discover what it took to create the overall game experience.    A Love Letter to Gaming: Hear firsthand about our passion for video games, what inspires us, and how our love for the medium influences our work.
Click here to listen to the podcast episode.

Join the Community:
Engage with the creators and other fans in the Steam Community Hub for "MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE." Share your thoughts on the podcast, ask questions, and discuss your favorite moments from the game with fellow cultists.

Visit the Community Hub

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: 🦑👁️ JAPANESE LOCALIZATION UPDATE 1.999! 👁️🦑
notes.content:
Dear Japanese-speaking followers, we extend our deepest gratitude for being part of our haunting journey! As we continue to explore the mysteries that lurk in the shadows, we invite you to plunge deeper into the abyss with the latest update for MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508716/1985ad2e0b6e70cfdf25a74a6729dd2a8a98cedb.png

🎌 EXPLORE THE UNSEEN IN YOUR NATIVE TONGUE!

Immerse yourself in the dark and mysterious world of our horror game, now fully localized in Japanese. From menus to dialogue and even the intricate lore, experience the terror and beauty of "MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE" like never before.

🔍 DISCOVER ALL 4 ENDINGS, UNRAVEL THE LORE!

Embark on a journey to unveil the secrets hidden within the game's narrative. Seek out all four endings, collect journal pages scattered throughout the eerie house, and capture chillingly cute moments in this refined version of the game.

🐞 BUG FIXES - A SMOOTHER NIGHTMARE AWAITS!

In our relentless pursuit of perfection, we've exorcised a lurking bug to ensure a smoother, more immersive experience. Your journey through the unknown is now free from eldritch interruptions.

🌐 MORE LANGUAGES ON THE HORIZON!

As we embrace the global community of horror enthusiasts, be on the lookout for additional language support in the coming year. The cultists know no bounds, and we're committed to bringing it to you in languages that resonate with terror.

👻 UPDATE NOW AND FACE THE UNSEEN IN JAPANESE!

Download the latest update for "MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE" on Steam and dive into the abyss with newfound terror in your native language. Unravel the mysteries, face the terrors, and remember - Cthulhu will rise again. 👁️🦑

notes.title: Update 1.666
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508716/e5b1477d5f0291acab7f0bda550a529a878ce437.png

We have just launched our first update for MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE with a few minor bug fixes and improvements to gameplay.

UPDATE NOTES: 

 Frame rate cap button added to options menu
 Escape key for options as default
 New warning screen to warn players  (and  set the mood)
 Decreased door interaction area
 Changed textures of the books and note pages to look better on lower resolutions
 Remade manga and night text graphics to be less pixelated
 TV static will always be the same volume and not randomized
 Fixed swinging doors so they can't trap players
 Disabled photomode diorama until it is visible
 Now screenshots are automatically added to your Steam library
 Made all doors and walls opaque 
 Opening books and acquiring letters now trigger sounds to make the 3D sounds that stop during pauses less abrupt 
 Changed text in the diorama to clarify options
 Tweaked drawer, lamp and note interaction ranges
 Added a button to the lamp to show where you should interact with it
 Added new logo to the photomode
 Tweaked photomode filters and frames
 Fixed UI elements in different resolutions


Please stay tuned for the next update coming out in December that will feature a Japanese translation.

Thank you for your continued support,

Virtua Worlds

notes.title: Coming soon, Press, Streamers, Fans
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508716/c8c588afe2a7ac1e03bace299e27c71f27ac209b.png
Thank you for the great reception of MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE. We have gotten some awesome feedback and many new cult members have joined since release.

MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE in the NEWS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508716/ba48ccc0f81981be85a0bdd5cc1717228c6d1c4a.png  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508716/a51cd96640dc923e61eac1a71978dd3692c013ec.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508716/8b4e2abe521012c4d8c7c204186849ccd8224aad.png

GAMESPARK. JP
本作は、ジャパニーズ・ホラーとラブクラフトが融合した短編ホラーゲーム。モノクロ漫画風のアートスタイルが特徴的です。プレイヤーは、夜中に起きる奇妙な音の正体と、娘の様子がおかしい理由を探り出します。
ENGLISH:
This is a short horror game that combines Japanese horror and Lovecraft. It features a monochrome manga style art style. Players must discover what strange noises are happening in the middle of the night and why their daughter is behaving strangely.

GAMEZEBO. COM
It’s a surreal experience and all rendered through clever use of shaders. While the game is made in 3D space, the textures do a great job of resembling black and white screen tones, so you immediately feel like you’re playing through the pages of a greyscale manga. Spooky.

GAMEBASE. COM

遊戲以強烈的黑白畫面帶出恐怖的氛圍，隨著玩家每天晚上的探索以及與家中物品的互動，女兒詭異行為的真相將
ENGLISH:
The game brings out a scary atmosphere with strong black and white graphics. As players explore and interact with items in their home every night, the truth about their daughter's strange behavior will gradually be revealed. 

COMING SOON

 A Minor Bug Patch to address a few issues from our Beta Testers.  We plan on making the menu easier to use, fixing some collision and photomode issues.
 A Major Update to include a Japanese translation. We have received many new Japanese fans and would like to make MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE more accessible to them. This update would also include a few more features that we have thought of since launch day.
